svg.text: SJ_LED: factory copper link; cut to disable, solder to restore.
Q_LED isolates LED current from PULSE. No pulse stretching; brief flashes.
GLOWCOST GEIGER | 3.3 V / CTC-5 / FOUR-WIRE PI INTERFACE
Functional schematic: U1 and U2 remain behavioral blocks. Not a fabrication release.
U1: L=1 mH, DCR=9.5 ohm; 10 kHz, 20 us ON; peak IL ~59 mA.
Input bypass in model: 22 uF. EN pulldown: 100k, ~33 uA when high.
Main FB = 1.242 V; separate OVP reference inhibits the driver.
C1-C8: 10 nF C0G, 630 V, 1206. D1-D8: BAV21W-7-F candidate.
SW peak ~106 V nominal; HV ~399 V. Stage labels are electrical nets.
Diode DC rating 200 V: verify individual reverse stress and hot leakage.
Four 33M / 2512 / 1% legs share HV stress. Each leg ~100 V / 0.30 mW.
Divider 3.02 uA at 400 V; C9 time constant ~41 us. Keep sense clean.
Separate divider AND reference; do not share the main-loop reference.
Open-feedback peak 412.67 V; 1% adverse corner 425.29 V (modeled).
R_A1/R_A2: EACH >=500 V working rating; mount close to the anode.
4.98M anode limit: <=88.4 uA at 440 V; Q1 emitter returns to GND.
D_NEG limits reverse VBE. U2: invert + EN / HV-ready / OVP blanking.
J2/J3: C142864, DNP at JLC; two pads of each clip share one electrode net.
Assume tube dead time ~190 us; plan 250 us pending tube/pulse tests.
Connected even with EN low / power absent.
EN LOW IS NOT PROOF OF DISCHARGE.
DESIGN NOTES: shared ground, no galvanic isolation. Keep HV physically separated from Pi wiring.
Plan 10 mA continuous / 20 mA average startup. INPUT INRUSH NOT LIMITED: add soft-start before Pi use.
See README.md for dead-time, conditional dose-rate conversion, power budget and calibration limits.
